note: Flora (`flora`, MG / Supporter / Electric / Burst II, cd 40s, ammo 300): a healer-buffer whose OWN MG damage is minor and whose value is TEAM-WIDE — her burst buffs, her S1 Peace-of-Mind HoT, and an S2 chain that her own S1 sets off once per burst rotation. THE S2 CHAIN — why `stageEnter{stage:2}` is the faithful trigger for two HP-worded kit lines, with no HP pool and no boss damage required: S1's third line grants Peace-of-Mind allies 'Max HP ▲ 15.01% of the skill user's max HP (WITHOUT restoring HP) for 2 sec' on entering Burst Stage 2; because current HP does not rise with max HP, each affected ally's HP FRACTION drops that instant to 1/1.1501 = 86.95%, i.e. below 90% -> S2-1's 'HP of an adjacent ally drops to 90% or below' is satisfied AT stage-2 entry, so the shield lands there; the shield landing on Flora herself satisfies S2-3's 'a shield is placed in front of this unit' on the same frame; and 2 sec later the Max HP grant expires, the allies' max HP returns to normal and they are therefore AT max HP -> S2-2's 'either adjacent ally reaches max HP' fires at stage-2 entry + 2 sec (`delaySec: 2`). `stageEnter{stage:2}` is therefore a DERIVED-DETERMINISTIC PROXY for the HP-threshold clause, not a re-trigger of a different kit line: the HP transition it stands in for is caused by Flora's own S1 on exactly that frame, every rotation, in every team — no boss damage, no other healer and no HP pool are involved. The 2-sec offset is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: Full Burst opens ~0.87 s after Burst Stage 2 entry (30f B2->B3 + 22f B3->FB), so a 10-sec buff starting at +0 s vs +2 s covers a materially different slice of the Full Burst window. MODELED: (skill2-1) `stageEnter{stage:2}` -> all allies -> `shield` maxHpPct 10.22 / 10s (no shield HP pool in v1; the effect emits the shield EVENT that opens `shielded` triggers and the `requiresShielded` window); (skill2-3) `shielded` -> selfAndAdjacent(sides 2) -> casterAtkPct 45.12 / 10s — '% of the skill user's ATK' is the caster-scaled flat-ATK path, and the target clause is 'all allies in the Peace of Mind state', i.e. the SAME set S1's Peace of Mind grants (selfAndAdjacent), NOT 'all allies' as in the other two S2 lines; (skill2-2) `stageEnter{stage:2}` + `delaySec: 2` -> all allies -> trueDamagePct 30.97 / 10s — flavor-gated by the engine (sim.ts), so it benefits only true-flavored damage; (burst) 'Restores HP = 10.45% of caster final Max HP' -> a `heal` to all allies on burstCast (no HP amount modeled — v1 has no HP pool — but it emits the recovery event that fires recovery-consumer teammates, e.g. crown's +20.99% Attack Damage); (burst) trueDamagePct 42.39 / 10s to all allies; (burst) casterAtkPct 85.86 / 10s to all allies (caster-scaled, NOT a plain atkPct, which would over-buff high-ATK carries and under-buff low-ATK ones); (skill1) 'Peace of Mind: Restores HP = 1% of caster final Max HP every 1 sec continuously' (self + both adjacent allies) -> an interval:1 `heal` to selfAndAdjacent(sides 2), modeling the kit's 1s recovery cadence (per-tick HP magnitude not modeled; the recovery EVENT cadence is, which is what recovery consumers key off). The 'activates at the start of battle as long as this unit is alive' clause is satisfied by the interval trigger running from battle start (units are immortal in v1). UNMODELED (verbatim lines in `unmodeled`, each with a structured caveat below): skill1 'Incoming Healing ▲ 4% continuously, stacks 5x' (no incomingHealingPct stat + no HP pool -> doubly inert); skill1 'after 100 normal attacks, all Electric Code allies: +1 stack to stackable buffs' (trigger hitCount:100 + target alliesOfElement Electric are expressible but the stack-increment EFFECT has no engine primitive -> engine-core flag); skill1's Max HP ▲ 15.01% grant is not modeled AS A STAT (ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct, e3 video rule, and 'without restoring HP' emits no recovery event) — but it is NOT damage-neutral, because it is the mechanism that fires the whole S2 chain above, which IS modeled. KIT-TEXT PROVENANCE: magnitudes are read from the blablalink prose SSOT (data/characters.json characters.flora.skills). The datamined `role.skillDetails` tables corroborate 90% / 10.22 / 30.97 / 10.45 / 42.39 / 100 attacks / 4% but are a PARTIAL capture of this kit — they omit S1's Burst-Stage-2 Max HP line, S2's shield->ATK line and the burst's ATK ▲ 85.86% line entirely, and they give the S2 True Damage duration as 5 sec where the prose says 10 sec. Prose wins per the blablalink-SSOT convention; the 5-vs-10 sec split is the one open magnitude question on this unit (docs/open-questions.md). SIDES: S1's HoT and S2-3 both use selfAndAdjacent(sides 2) — they must agree, since 'the Peace of Mind state' IS the S1 target set. Whether `sides` should be 1 (self + one ally each side, which is how the prose 'self and both adjacent allies' reads) rather than 2 is a cross-unit question shared with `rouge`, filed in docs/open-questions.md; it is not settled here. PINNED end-to-end by scripts/tests/units/flora.test.ts (F1 burst casterAtkPct 85.86 is caster-scaled not target-scaled; F2 burst trueDamagePct 42.39 is flavor-gated; F3/F4 burst heal + S1 HoT emit recovery events that drive crown's recovery consumer; F5 the shield is the SOLE cause of the S2-3 ATK buff; F6 S2-3 reaches the Peace-of-Mind set only, not all five allies; F7 S2-2 lands exactly 120 frames after stage-2 entry and on no entry frame; F8 the S2 slot is load-bearing) and by the primitive spec scripts/tests/engine/block-delay.test.ts.

skill1: Incoming Healing ▲ 4% continuously. Stacks up to 5 times. — no incomingHealingPct stat exists and v1 models no HP pool, so healing-received scaling is doubly inert (damage-neutral).

■ Activates when entering Burst Stage 2. Affects all allies in the Peace of Mind state. Max HP ▲ 15.01% of the skill user's max HP (without restoring HP) for 2 sec. — the Max HP STAT is not granted (ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct, e3 video rule; 'without restoring HP' so no recovery event). Its CONSEQUENCE is modeled: the 86.95% HP fraction it forces, and the return to max HP 2 sec later, are what the skill2 blocks' `stageEnter{stage:2}` (+ `delaySec: 2`) triggers stand in for.

caveats: skill2 (trigger form) ⚑ derived-deterministic: the three S2 lines are worded as HP triggers ('HP drops to 90% or below', 'reaches max HP', 'a shield is placed in front of this unit'), and v1 models no HP pool. They are keyed to Burst Stage 2 entry instead, because Flora's own S1 forces exactly those HP transitions there: the 2-sec Max HP ▲ 15.01% grant (without restoring HP) drops Peace-of-Mind allies to 86.95% HP at stage-2 entry, and returns them to max HP 2 sec later. The proxy is exact for the self-procced chain; what it does NOT represent is any ADDITIONAL firing driven by real boss damage (a raid boss that damages allies would re-open the 'HP ≤ 90%' trigger between rotations), so this is a floor on the line's real uptime, not a ceiling.

skill2 (True Damage duration) ⚑ kit-text conflict: modeled at 10 sec per the blablalink prose SSOT; the datamined skill2 table gives 5 sec for the same line. That datamined capture is partial for this unit (it is missing three kit lines outright), which is why prose wins here. ESTIMATE: halving the window would cut this line's Full-Burst overlap roughly in half. RECIPE: a fresh datamine of skill group 24112, or a footage read of the buff icon's lifetime. TIER: open magnitude question.

skill1 (stack bump): 'after 100 normal attacks, all Electric Code allies: Increases the stack count of stackable buffs by 1' is now modeled as hitCount:100 -> alliesOfElement Electric addStack 1. It only affects Electric-Code allies' currently-live stackable buffs; the magnitude depends on which stack-ramp buffs are active on those allies.

skill1 (Incoming Healing) ⚑ inert: 'Incoming Healing ▲ 4% continuously, stacks 5x' — no incomingHealingPct stat and no HP pool, so it scales only heals received (unmodeled). ESTIMATE: damage-neutral. RECIPE: none for DPS (would need an HP pool + incomingHealingPct stat). TIER: inert/out-of-domain.

skill1 (Max HP grant) ⚑ modeled by consequence: 'entering Burst Stage 2 -> Peace-of-Mind allies Max HP ▲ 15.01% of caster Max HP for 2 sec (without restoring HP)'. The Max HP stat itself is not granted (offensively inert — ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct, e3 video rule — and it emits no recovery event). It is not damage-neutral, though: it is the mechanism that drives the whole S2 chain, which is modeled on `stageEnter{stage:2}` and `stageEnter{stage:2}` + `delaySec: 2` in the skill2 blocks.

burst/skill1 heals: the HP MAGNITUDES (burst 10.45%, HoT 1%/s) are not modeled (no HP pool) — only the recovery EVENT cadence is, which is what recovery-consumer teammates key off. The interval:1 HoT phase starts at t=1s (engine interval convention 'first at t=sec'); a t=0 first tick would add one extra early recovery event, immaterial to steady-state consumer uptime.
